checks: new unsaved document uses frozen current bytes with history off; canceled creation and selection do not save or restore
busy create locks editing, tabs, duplicate submission, and Escape; success preserves the editor
opened document includes history only after opt-in, retains original BOM/CRLF/revision, and reports existing-backup refusal
actual resource Worker rejects absent image inventory, releases rejected tokens, and native corrupt-package errors block restore
explicit restore review uses Worker-scanned AST references, excludes inline fake images, and handles canceled, changed, and expired packages
reselection invalidates confirmation and releases old token; long names fit compact layout; busy restore is locked and leaves editor/disk unchanged
closing releases the active token and F1 exposes the same backup action with fresh default state
scope: Production UI and actual resource Worker with deterministic native IPC. Real archive/filesystem behavior is covered by Rust tests; native dialogs, native GUI, and IME are not asserted.
